**Braid group $B_n$.** Artin's group on $n$ strands generated by elementary crossings $\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_{n-1}$ subject to far commutativity $\sigma_i\sigma_j = \sigma_j\sigma_i$ for $|i - j| \ge 2$ and the braid relation $\sigma_i\sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i = \sigma_{i+1}\sigma_i\sigma_{i+1}$; for $n = 3$, $B_3 = \langle \sigma_1, \sigma_2 \mid \sigma_1\sigma_2\sigma_1 = \sigma_2\sigma_1\sigma_2 \rangle$ is isomorphic to the fundamental group of the trefoil complement (see [three-strand braid group](#def:braid-group)). By Alexander's and Markov's theorems, every oriented link in $S^3$ arises as the closure $\widehat{\beta}$ of a braid $\beta \in B_n$, unique up to conjugation and Markov stabilization.
